task: ae.deflate: DEFLATE/zlib codec from scratch (inflate all block types, LZ77+fixed Huffman deflate, Adler-32) verified against JDK Deflater/Inflater
reasoning_summary: Built bit reader/writer, puff-style canonical Huffman decoder, a full inflate (stored/fixed/dynamic) with output cap, and a hash-chain LZ77 compressor emitting fixed Huffman or stored blocks, plus zlib/Adler-32. The JDK Deflater/Inflater served as independent oracles at all levels, with exhaustive truncation and byte-flip corruption tests and two mutation checks.
